title: Rigorix Native API — error model v1
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error objects for the native rigorix.* API (ADR-0001 D6). `data.type` is the stable machine identifier; `message` is human text and may change. `denied_by_sequence` MUST carry data.rule_id and data.step when known. ADR-017 R1: a dispatch-time precondition refusal is a `policy_violation` carrying `data.precondition_id` + `data.step` + `data.outcome`, and is never retryable (`retryable: false`).

step.description: Step refused by policy, when known.

precondition_id.description: ADR-017 R1: the precondition id for a dispatch-time authority refusal (`data.type` = policy_violation).

outcome.description: ADR-017 R1: the precondition outcome that refused dispatch. `failed` / `error` / `unarmed` all refuse; none is retryable.

x-precondition-denial.note: ADR-017 R1: a dispatch-time precondition refusal. The step's tool is never called, and the determination is recorded in the signed envelope's precondition_findings[]. There is no allow-on-error mode in v1 (fail closed).
